title: linnaeopsis heckmanniana subsp. gracilis
intro: Linnaeopsis heckmanniana subsp. gracilis, commonly known as the Gracile Linnaeopsis, is a plant species within the family Rutaceae, native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Linnaeopsis heckmanniana subsp. gracilis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce stress, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and limonoids, which contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
